metadata.description: Marketplace for plugins shipped with the agents-in-a-box / ai-coder-rules toolkit. Plugins live under toolkit/packages/plugins/ and are installable via `claude plugin install <name>@agents-in-a-box`.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Agent self-improvement + retrieval. Captures learnings via colon-namespaced sub-skills (reflect, reflect:consolidate, reflect:ingest, reflect:recall, reflect-status) and auto-injects relevant prior learnings at SessionStart via hook.
